conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Namaste, main Rekha Patel. Mera fixed deposit mature ho gaya, ab kya karoon?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Rekha ji, main aapki madad karoonga. Kya aap FD number bata sakti hain?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Maine dekha, aapki FD mature ho chuki hai. Kya aap amount withdraw karna chahti hain ya renew karna hai?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Main withdraw karna chahti hoon. Kitna time lagega?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Amount 24 ghante mein aapke account mein credit ho jayega. Main process start kar deta hoon. Koi aur madad?
